ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Welfare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of welfare fraud in Minnesota, with a focus on child care programs
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What is the extent of welfare fraud in Minnesota?
How have state officials responded to the issue?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread abuse of welfare programs and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money and analyzing public records, we can shed light on the extent of the problem and identify areas for improvement.
